summary: The nixos-shared-defaults-extraction feature has been successfully implemented and reviewed. The worker removed 6 redundant settings from forge and sentry host configs: systemd.network.links (mkForce {}), networking.cluster-hosts, services.unbound-common.enable, security.caddyCa.enable, services.status-auto-update.enable, and programs.nix-ld.enable. All settings were already present in common-host-defaults.nix with proper lib.mkDefault usage. The implementation eliminates 23 lines of duplication while maintaining full behavioral equivalence. All verification steps passed including nix flake check, nix eval confirmations, and successful builds. No issues or convention violations found.
